verdict.rationale: Microsoft's transparency note says Copilot grounds its responses in high-ranking web content and gives hyperlinked citations after generated answers. This is the core of the story. Researcher (docs-5) adds support for finding and synthesizing information. Missing for 10: explicit documentation that results are current or real-time, and independent or hands-on confirmation of citation accuracy.

support.subject: As a knowledge-worker, I can get answers grounded in current web results with citations back to the sources

citations.quote: Copilot centers its response on high-ranking content from the web and provides hyperlinked citations following generated text responses
Find, synthesize, and understand information faster with Researcher.
